# bronto_sso_idp (Resource)

Manages a Bronto SSO identity provider (SAML or OIDC).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bronto_sso_idp" "okta" {
  name          = "Okta"
  provider_type = "SAML"
  identifiers   = ["bronto.io"]
  meta_cert     = file("${path.module}/okta-metadata.xml")

  attribute_mappings = [
    {
      provider_attr = "givenname"
      user_attr     = "name"
    }
  ]
}

# OIDC providers use issuer_url/client_id/client_secret instead of
# meta_cert.
resource "bronto_sso_idp" "google" {
  name          = "Google"
  provider_type = "OIDC"
  issuer_url    = "https://accounts.google.com"
  client_id     = var.google_oidc_client_id
  client_secret = var.google_oidc_client_secret

  attribute_mappings = [
    {
      provider_attr = "email"
      user_attr     = "email"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attribute_mappings` (Attributes List) Maps identity provider attributes to Bronto user attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_mappings))
- `name` (String) The name of the identity provider. Identifies the resource; cannot be changed after creation.
- `provider_type` (String) The federated sign-in option: `SAML` or `OIDC`.

### Optional

- `accept_idp_initiated` (Boolean) When enabled, sign-in sessions can be initiated from the identity provider rather than from Bronto. Not recommended: this makes the integration more susceptible to spoofing and cross-site request forgery.
- `client_id` (String) The client id this application was registered with on the OIDC identity provider. Required for OIDC providers.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret used to authenticate with the OIDC identity provider. Required for OIDC providers.
- `identifiers` (List of String) Email address domains that redirect a user to this identity provider for sign-in, e.g. `["bronto.io"]`.
- `issuer_url` (String) The base URL of the OIDC identity provider, e.g. `https://dev-123456.okta.com/oauth2/default`. Required for OIDC providers.
- `meta_cert` (String) The SAML identity provider's metadata XML (its signing certificate and endpoints). Required for SAML providers.

### Read-Only

- `app_client_id` (String) The AWS Cognito application client id used to build this identity provider's sign-in start URL.
- `id` (String) The identity provider's name - this resource has no separate generated id, so `id` and `name` are always equal.

<a id="nestedatt--attribute_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attribute_mappings`

Required:

- `provider_attr` (String) The attribute name from the identity provider to map from, e.g. `givenname`.
- `user_attr` (String) The Bronto user attribute to map to, e.g. `name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# SSO identity providers are imported by name - this resource has no
# separate generated id.
terraform import bronto_sso_idp.okta Okta

# Alternatively, the Bronto API can generate a ready-to-paste bronto_sso_idp
# block (including its own `import` block) for an existing identity
# provider directly. client_secret is never returned by the API, so an
# OIDC export will need it filled in by hand afterward:
#   GET /sso/idps/{idp_name}/export?format=terraform
```
